name: Zimeldine

own_problems.text: Pulled from the market worldwide, first in 1983 — for liver harm and nerve and brain harm

summary: Zimeldine was removed from the market across the world starting in 1983 due to liver damage as well as injury to the nerves and brain [3]. A small computer model, rather than tests conducted on human patients, produced liver and heart scores for the drug [M]. This computer model categorized both the liver score of 44 and the heart score of 34 into a low band [M].
